The separate living/nonliving lifecycle below is authored data, not a change of type. Ordinary printed profiles have one ordinary Action per actual regular turn, one ordinary Reaction refreshed at their actual regular START, actual movement and no free Bonus Action. Native Multiattack supplies subattacks inside one Action; it supplies no extra turn. No CR-derived PB is invented: printed attack modifiers/DCs control; otherwise unlisted ability checks/saves use the printed natural modifier only. Skills require an actual separate entitlement. sharedRules.wording: For these proposed profiles only use the explicit per-body box and weight in each procedure. Occupancy is the interior of that box; mere boundary contact is not overlap. A body cannot voluntarily end in solid matter or another body's interior. Range/reach is minimum Euclidean separation between actual occupied bodies; a target can be hit at exactly the stated maximum. An area needs a real interior intersection and line of effect from its declared outlet/center to a point in that same intersection. No witness on an unexposed face suffices. Cone geometry is axial 0<s<=length and perpendicular radius<=s/2, excluding the rear half-space. A spherical area uses its stated center/radius. Whole-body fit and actual collision/support are required throughout movement and arrival. Positive-body intersection, not a token-center test, governs these local areas. These shapes do not replace another accepted spell's grid/continuous conventions. Sight/perception, cover, light and knowledge are separate: knowing a location supplies no sight. Native ranged attacks within five feet of a hostile creature that sees the attacker use the actual close-combat disadvantage. Real half/three-quarter cover adds its actual +2/+5; total cover blocks the required path. A larger body neither sees nor attacks through a wall by default.

An ordinary native attack can be used as one Action. Multiattack commits one Action, records its chosen permitted sequence and resolves the printed count in order, choosing legal recipients and actual available body outlets for each subattack. NEW: any listed damaging attack procedure, including a save-based or recharge action, can occupy one slot; a recharge action is available only while its real charge exists, consumes that charge at its own commitment, and cannot be repeated from the same charge. This gives effect to 'using the actions below' without inventing additional Actions. A miss still spends its slot. An illegal later subattack may select another otherwise legal recipient before its own commitment; it cannot change an already rolled result, add an unlisted effect or refund the Action. Actual incapacitation or source/target removal stops whatever can no longer legally occur. Each genuine subattack is a new original-dealer damage root; multiattack parent action ID and subattack ordinal remain recorded. The full native Action is one source-use for a conversion entitlement unless an actual external contract explicitly says otherwise; subattack descendants cannot multiply the same converted use. Root identity and source-use identity are distinct. Counterspell cannot interrupt an untagged nonspell attack merely because its damage is magical. Ordinary Ready triggers finish first; a telegraph supplies no new interrupt or Reaction.

sharedRules.kind: INHERIT exact Core/Healing/Null; NEW lifecycle bindings

DC=max(10,floor(post-temp/2)); subtract pre-event Wounds from the CON save. Failure adds one Wound; a fourth Wound kills. Failure by at least5 also uses the actual d6 injury result. Do not reduce maximum HP merely because a Wound was added: Critical's ordinary-heal ceiling is not a maximum-HP clamp. Ordinary monsters reaching zero die/end after their actual life sequence unless a real valid knockout or source override applies. Significant-NPC death-save handling must be declared before the event. Death is distinct from zero, suppression, disappearance, and harvest availability. Each attack names the creature as dealer; controller Null does not transfer to it. A qualifying actual Null root inherits its original dealer snapshot; it prevents only the applicable damage-caused lethal/Wound endpoint and keeps non-damage costs and riders. Ordinary living profiles use Stable0 and the one actual Stable clock. Printed Constructs are explicitly nonliving Constructs and use accepted Null Disabled0 without creating salvage. NEW for only the four printed Undead here: ordinary damage at zero destroys the same body into its finite native remains; a qualifying Null root instead leaves the same nonliving body Null Disabled0, no corpse/soul/loot. This is not the named Silence Wraith projection rule, a resurrection, generic repair or a global Undead physiology. Only a real compatible recovery source restores a disabled nonliving body. sharedRules.kind: NEW completion of eight printed recharge actions
sharedRules.wording: A recharge record stores actorId/actionId, ready/spent, original last-use event, first-use telegraph START, and roll receipts. NEW default allocation chooses one uniform eligible-category starting ordinal, then round-robin in printed row order up to declared anatomical caps; the lead cannot redirect omitted categories into the most expensive one. A partial harvest forfeits unselected ordinary categories under the actual generic rule. Source-qualified reserve units are separately identified before use and never created to satisfy an awarded count. A specific body's surviving anatomy can cap a category below the pool. Native specific skill/DC/base time govern its dossier route; missing Shardling/Sentinel fields receive the explicit new values below. Identification remains the actual knowledge/Medicine procedure. On a genuine extraction Success recover the selected units; Critical Success additionally recovers one previously damaged but still recoverable selected unit, never beyond the registered cap; Failure ruins the highest-value selected unit and recovers none; Critical Failure ruins all selected units and applies the declared actual hazard, or the Core's1d4 minor accident if none exists. NEW work-clock completion: an interrupted ordinary extraction retains only recorded actual active seconds and physically usable partial work; the lead resumes the remaining requirement if the same units still qualify. No time credits while paused, studying, traveling, resting or doing another task. This is a local extraction ledger, not research/manufacturing phases or a global scheduler tick. A completed failed/critically failed selection is exhausted and cannot begin a new generic attempt. A paused unfinished selection gets no new yield roll or stock. No free reroll/yield refresh. A source-qualified actual helper contributes only through the applicable current rule, never from unit count or body parts. Parts from sentient recipients require the real consent/authority/dark-path permission the crafting source demands; this review grants none. Field extraction is not creation, so FT84's Craftsman completion does not halve it. Raw names such as meat do not establish edibility, ingredient identity or a meal. Keep donor-local unit identity, actual weight/container, Tier and reference value; EX58 governs actual custody, transport, lawful settlement and actual buyer valuation. Do not add inventory and also credit the same unit as Supply. No harvest occurs on living, Stable0, NullDisabled, sequestered, absent or merely released creatures. NEW allocation clarification: when several eligible source categories compete for a small total pool, choose a uniform initial category ordinal once, then distribute round-robin in source order within actual anatomy/mass caps. All categories can be actual outcomes; no highest-value choice or global duplicate drop is introduced. This allocation is frozen before worker selection.

Real retreat leaves actual cargo, mounts, downed bodies and witness histories where their sources place them; success awards no second kill, material bundle, generic XP or faction change. An encounter boundary does not reset resource/source receipts unless their actual rule says it does.

tactics.originalHowItFights: It opens with **Rage Rend** against the target most capable of controlling its movement. It uses **Life Drain** to punish anyone who tries to stabilize that target. It attacks the character whose behavior most closely matches its defining loss.
tactics.originalHowToDefeat:
**Prepare Before Contact**

- Prepare resistance or mitigation for necrotic damage.
- Agree on verbal and physical contact signals before entry.

**Combat Priority**

Identify the repeated emotion and stop feeding it before striking the exposed core.

**Exploit**

The defining weakness is **breaking the emotional loop**. Treat this as an encounter solution rather than an automatic damage vulnerability. Successful Research, Recon, or Resource actions should make the exploit easier or safer.

**Withdraw When**

Withdraw or change the objective when its full multiattack reaches the support line; resources fall below half before the arena mechanic is solved. A failed retreat against this creature usually costs more than abandoning the immediate treasure.
tactics.originalHabitat:
Their territory accumulates symbolic objects. Destroying every object can strengthen the entity by confirming its loss; identifying the central memory is safer.

Grief-Bound are emotional deaths that found enough matter or Resonance to keep moving. They are not ordinary ghosts. Each is a self-reinforcing need that hunts situations capable of repeating the moment that made it.

Some can be quieted, redirected, or released if the original loss is understood. False promises often produce a stronger return.

harvest.identification: One minute actual close examination: native knowledge skill/INT, except Medicine/WIS; actual relevant proficiency only. One actually trained assistant+1 spends the same minute. Success exposes real recorded categories, hazards and clocks, not unobserved hidden sources. Failure no hidden qualities; plainly recognizable unidentified work may proceed at the actual disadvantage. No unchanged-evidence roll spam.
harvest.extraction: The printed body-level skill/DC/time expressly governs removal for this source, overriding generic body time/DC; missing two use their labelled completion. It authorizes that actual skill as a removal route but grants neither training nor tools. A properly qualified actual gathering trade can supply its own genuine route. No double PB from skill plus tool. One eligible assistant+1 spends the entire extraction time.
harvest.manifestAlgorithm: At actual remains availability, assign remainsId/bodyId/deathTime and all prior damage/custody/claims. Roll one size pool (Tiny1, Small1d2, Medium1d4, Large2d4,Huge4d4) under the accepted finite framework. Resolve each native category availability d100 once. NEW allocation: order eligible categories by original occurrence; if more than one, roll uniform starting ordinal 1..N and distribute the one pool round-robin from there, respecting each actual anatomical cap and measured remaining mass. No eligible category means pool yields nothing. Record fixed unit IDs/allocation before worker choice; do not redirect forfeited quantities. One actual unit cannot belong to two categories. No exceptional additive drop is inferred here.
harvest.selectionAndTime: Choose categories from the complete available manifest. Full time is this exact source time; partial time is ceil(fullMinutes*chosenCategories/availableCategories), minimum1minute. All unselected ordinary categories are forfeited when work begins. Hurry halves that actual required time with upward minute rounding and disadvantage. No Craftsman/Spell Scribe research/manufacturing discount shortens harvest.
harvest.workAndInterruption: NEW harvest-only physical progress completion: record actual exclusive active seconds of usable removal work; safe pauses retain only physically usable progress, clocks continue and real damage can destroy work/stock. No crafting incorporation stabilization or study-phase clock is imported. An interrupted unfinished attempt resumes the same selected finite units and original receipts, not a new yield roll. Completed failure exhausts that selected attempt. Another worker requires genuine access/skill and inherits existing physical progress, never duplicated hours or fresh material.
harvest.resolution: Core four-degree extraction check. Success recovers selected intact allocated units. Critical success additionally saves at most one predeclared damaged/recoverable selected unit within the same anatomical cap; no nonexistent bonus. Failure ruins the highest-reference selected unit (actual tie choice recorded), recovers none, and exhausts selection. Critical failure ruins all selected units, with only actual declared hazard; absent one, real1d4 minor physical accident to lead. No new retry or repeated corpse conversion.
harvest.custodyAndAftermath: Award actual identified lots once at completion, with source occurrence, unit ID, quantity, weight, current condition, clock, owner/claimant and custodian kept separate. Real carried gear is separate and not duplicated by harvest. Humanoid/celestial remains require actual consent/lawful authority/explicit dark-path source. A destroyed or Null-disabled living body is not automatically eligible remains. Magical projections, companions and Simulacra keep their own accepted no-farming/lifecycle procedures.
harvest.noGuaranteedEquivalence: Every global material/recipe-name comparison is retained separately. A source-local unit is not that named catalog ingredient until actual properties/tier/form/amount/provenance satisfy the accepted exact card or a legitimate substitution record. Unresolved recipe labels remain unresolved references, not approved formulas or nonexistent history.

A save is binary meeting DC; natural20 is not automatic save success. Use actual typed defenses and temporary HP, then actual normal-HP loss and overkill. CORE ordering: lethal instant-death threshold precedes a living recipient's Wound check; otherwise one qualifying Wound check occurs on positive-to-zero or post-temp damage at least half effective maximum. DC=max(10,floor(post-temp/2)); subtract pre-event Wounds from the CON save. Failure adds one Wound; a fourth Wound kills. Failure by at least5 also uses the actual d6 injury result. Do not reduce maximum HP merely because a Wound was added: Critical's ordinary-heal ceiling is not a maximum-HP clamp. Ordinary monsters reaching zero die/end after their actual life sequence unless a real valid knockout or source override applies. Significant-NPC death-save handling must be declared before the event. Death is distinct from zero, suppression, disappearance, and harvest availability. Each attack names the creature as dealer; controller Null does not transfer to it. A qualifying actual Null root inherits its original dealer snapshot; it prevents only the applicable damage-caused lethal/Wound endpoint and keeps non-damage costs and riders. Ordinary living profiles use Stable0 and the one actual Stable clock. Printed Constructs are explicitly nonliving Constructs and use accepted Null Disabled0 without creating salvage. knowledge.original:
Use **Arcana** unless the Director approves a more specific approach.

| Result | Information Learned |
|---|---|
| DC 14 | Creature family, usual habitat, and dominant attack type. |
| DC 18 | The first reliable counter and the sign that its strongest ability is ready. |

knowledge.procedure: Retain each dossier's knowledge skill alternatives and its three actual DC thresholds. A focused identification attempt uses one real Search/Research Action in combat with actual observable signs or examined remains, or one uninterrupted minute of ordinary examination outside combat. Use the real acquired skill and underlying ability, actual helpers and conditions; no stat-block or hidden roster is supplied merely by selecting a UI row. Meeting successive printed thresholds reveals only the corresponding family/habitat/dominant type, actual first counter/telegraph, then relevant weakness/harvest/retreat facts. A failed attempt does not create false certainty; an identical unaltered evidence check cannot be spammed. New direct observations can update specific facts without retroactively exposing unknown identities. Recognizing a creature is not knowing its language, reading its contract or receiving a public route. LAX keeps speaking/comprehension/reading/writing/script and physical channels distinct. Individual proposed language competencies below are explicit NEW roster defaults, not grants to observers, all members of an ancestry or unnamed populations. Actual anatomy, silence, hearing, light and usable writing tools still govern communication. Social credentials and promises use actual EX58 records; a failed negotiation is not an invented charm, compelled confession or global reputation loss.

tactics.originalHowItFights: It opens with **Ash Claw** against the target most capable of controlling its movement. It uses **Cinder Lash** to punish anyone who tries to stabilize that target. When **Hollow Wail** recharges, it delays only if it can catch a more important cluster or interrupt a decisive ritual. It escalates by phase and uses the Seal Pulse to punish parties that solve damage but ignore the test.
tactics.originalHowToDefeat:
**Prepare Before Contact**

- Prepare resistance or mitigation for necrotic, fire damage.
- Carry ranged attacks, grounding tools, or vertical cover.
- Spread before **Hollow Wail** becomes available.

**Combat Priority**

Complete the arena objective while maintaining damage pressure.

**Exploit**

The defining weakness is **None identified**. Treat this as an encounter solution rather than an automatic damage vulnerability. Successful Research, Recon, or Resource actions should make the exploit easier or safer.

**Withdraw When**

Withdraw or change the objective when Hollow Wail catches three or more Expedition members; resources fall below half before the arena mechanic is solved. A failed retreat against this creature usually costs more than abandoning the immediate treasure.
tactics.originalHabitat:
A Gate arena is part of the creature. Terrain, Seal Pulses, objectives, and failure conditions matter as much as hit points.

Gate Guardians are not random apex monsters. Each is a living examination tied to a Division of the dungeon, a Gate Seal, and a principle the Expedition must demonstrate under pressure.

Some Guardians speak, bargain, or test. None are safely reduced to ordinary patrons or quest-givers.
tactics.procedure: At each actual regular START choose from the creature's real perceptions, remembered observations and declared objective: an actual legal source-specific objective/counter first; otherwise the printed How It Fights opening attack, a ready announced area only if its visible recipients suit the objective, then a legal native sequence. A failed path or unavailable target does not grant hidden location knowledge or teleportation. A territorial withdrawal decision and an intelligent surrender/parley are choices, not conditions that remove a player's agency. To disengage under threat the creature must spend its own actual Withdraw/Disengage Action and actual movement, or bear ordinary opportunity-attack risk; no guaranteed escape or unearned pursuit distance. Exact route geometry, hazards, loads and chase transitions come from actual EX58 inputs. Adjacent enemies, line of sight and cover are recomputed before each real movement segment. Real retreat leaves actual cargo, mounts, downed bodies and witness histories where their sources place them; success awards no second kill, material bundle, generic XP or faction change. An encounter boundary does not reset resource/source receipts unless their actual rule says it does.
tactics.arenaNarrativeBoundary: Gate test victory, alleged origins, memories and route rewards remain source narrative, not automatic hidden mechanics. An unprinted Seal Pulse is not a second new damage action; the printed recharge supplies the operational burst until separately authored evidence says otherwise.

phaseAndMovement.gateAndArena: An actual arena/anchor is a scene input with real location and state. Missing scene content prevents that particular scene-dependent predicate, not the native damage attacks.

profiles.defenseProcedure: Use exact printed typed defenses; disease label is prevention of actual disease acquisition/progression only, not a damage type, Poison immunity or resistance to every associated attack. Real direct damage and non-disease riders remain. Resolve attack rolls with natural1 miss/natural20 hit and doubled dice only, not doubled flat modifiers. CORE ordering: lethal instant-death threshold precedes a living recipient's Wound check; otherwise one qualifying Wound check occurs on positive-to-zero or post-temp damage at least half effective maximum. DC=max(10,floor(post-temp/2)); subtract pre-event Wounds from the CON save. Failure adds one Wound; a fourth Wound kills. Failure by at least5 also uses the actual d6 injury result. Do not reduce maximum HP merely because a Wound was added: Critical's ordinary-heal ceiling is not a maximum-HP clamp. Ordinary monsters reaching zero die/end after their actual life sequence unless a real valid knockout or source override applies. Significant-NPC death-save handling must be declared before the event. Death is distinct from zero, suppression, disappearance, and harvest availability. Each attack names the creature as dealer; controller Null does not transfer to it. A qualifying actual Null root inherits its original dealer snapshot; it prevents only the applicable damage-caused lethal/Wound endpoint and keeps non-damage costs and riders. Ordinary living profiles use Stable0 and the one actual Stable clock. Printed Constructs are explicitly nonliving Constructs and use accepted Null Disabled0 without creating salvage. NEW for only the four printed Undead here: ordinary damage at zero destroys the same body into its finite native remains; a qualifying Null root instead leaves the same nonliving body Null Disabled0, no corpse/soul/loot. This is not the named Silence Wraith projection rule, a resurrection, generic repair or a global Undead physiology. Only a real compatible recovery source restores a disabled nonliving body. Roots, life events and finite-remains claims are durable and idempotent. traits.procedure: NEW TM02. Declare a genuine food cache, young/den or open retreat route and the creature's territorial objective before initiative. At its regular END, actual security of that object or actual removal of the encroaching threat can set a break-off intention. On its next real turn it chooses the safe known Withdraw/Disengage route using its normal Action and movement; if blocked it can defend rather than teleport. It ceases voluntary pursuit after the objective remains secure and visible foes leave its territory. Bait is real stock, a controlled den is real space and an exit must fit the body. A party's arbitrary claim 'food secured' or animal name does not force morale. This is a deterministic default goal policy with actual inputs, not Charmed, a skill-check mind-control action or a guaranteed surrender.

knowledge.original:
Use **History or Insight** unless the Director approves a more specific approach.

| Result | Information Learned |
|---|---|
| DC 12 | Creature family, usual habitat, and dominant attack type. |
| DC 16 | The first reliable counter and the sign that its strongest ability is ready. |
| DC 20 | Its defining tactical weakness, safe harvest method, and likely retreat condition. |
knowledge.procedure: Retain each dossier's knowledge skill alternatives and its three actual DC thresholds. A focused identification attempt uses one real Search/Research Action in combat with actual observable signs or examined remains, or one uninterrupted minute of ordinary examination outside combat. Use the real acquired skill and underlying ability, actual helpers and conditions; no stat-block or hidden roster is supplied merely by selecting a UI row. Meeting successive printed thresholds reveals only the corresponding family/habitat/dominant type, actual first counter/telegraph, then relevant weakness/harvest/retreat facts. A failed attempt does not create false certainty; an identical unaltered evidence check cannot be spammed. New direct observations can update specific facts without retroactively exposing unknown identities. Recognizing a creature is not knowing its language, reading its contract or receiving a public route. LAX keeps speaking/comprehension/reading/writing/script and physical channels distinct. Individual proposed language competencies below are explicit NEW roster defaults, not grants to observers, all members of an ancestry or unnamed populations. Actual anatomy, silence, hearing, light and usable writing tools still govern communication. Social credentials and promises use actual EX58 records; a failed negotiation is not an invented charm, compelled confession or global reputation loss.

tactics.originalHowItFights: It opens with **Heavy Blow** against the target most capable of controlling its movement. It uses **Off-hand Strike** to punish anyone who tries to stabilize that target. It attacks from concealment, protects its escape path, and stops pursuing once territory or food is secured.
tactics.originalHowToDefeat:
**Prepare Before Contact**

- Prepare resistance or mitigation for bludgeoning, piercing damage.
- Carry bait, scent control, and a noncombat retreat route.

**Combat Priority**

Control its escape and feeding choices rather than cornering it.

**Exploit**

The defining weakness is **None identified**. Treat this as an encounter solution rather than an automatic damage vulnerability. Successful Research, Recon, or Resource actions should make the exploit easier or safer.

**Withdraw When**

Withdraw or change the objective when the creature reaches favorable terrain or isolates a target. A failed retreat against this creature usually costs more than abandoning the immediate treasure.
tactics.originalHabitat:
Predators choose terrain that hides approach and protects retreat. The lair is usually more dangerous than the animal.

Not every dangerous creature serves a faction or cosmic principle. Ordinary predators become expedition-level threats when dungeon terrain, repeated Openings, or magical food chains reshape them.

Animal Handling, food, territory, and nonthreatening movement matter more than language.
tactics.procedure: At each actual regular START choose from the creature's real perceptions, remembered observations and declared objective: an actual legal source-specific objective/counter first; otherwise the printed How It Fights opening attack, a ready announced area only if its visible recipients suit the objective, then a legal native sequence. A failed path or unavailable target does not grant hidden location knowledge or teleportation. A territorial withdrawal decision and an intelligent surrender/parley are choices, not conditions that remove a player's agency. To disengage under threat the creature must spend its own actual Withdraw/Disengage Action and actual movement, or bear ordinary opportunity-attack risk; no guaranteed escape or unearned pursuit distance. Exact route geometry, hazards, loads and chase transitions come from actual EX58 inputs. Adjacent enemies, line of sight and cover are recomputed before each real movement segment. Real retreat leaves actual cargo, mounts, downed bodies and witness histories where their sources place them; success awards no second kill, material bundle, generic XP or faction change. An encounter boundary does not reset resource/source receipts unless their actual rule says it does.
tactics.arenaNarrativeBoundary: Gate test victory, alleged origins, memories and route rewards remain source narrative, not automatic hidden mechanics. An unprinted Seal Pulse is not a second new damage action; the printed recharge supplies the operational burst until separately authored evidence says otherwise.

phaseAndMovement.timeline: Cases supply numbered-round/turn identities as encounter fixtures; no global seconds-to-round mapping is adopted.
phaseAndMovement.terrainAndStances: Actual Dash/Withdraw/Guard/Brace/Ready/Hide/Search/Help and movement budgets use their accepted Core/Combat action procedures. Narrative Astral Ascetic Enlightened counterplay grants no free off-turn movement.
phaseAndMovement.gateAndArena: An actual arena/anchor is a scene input with real location and state. Missing scene content prevents that particular scene-dependent predicate, not the native damage attacks.
phaseAndMovement.formationMembership: Printed named units are single actors with explicit member IDs. Other nearby constructs are not joined or cloned by name; Sentinel networks require actual separate bodies.
phaseAndMovement.resetBoundary: No reset on body-fragment selection, mode transition, duplicate event, save/load or alternate route. Real source-ending/reset events retain their exact authority.

tactics.originalHowItFights: It opens with **Mauling Claws** against the target most capable of controlling its movement. It uses **Bite** to punish anyone who tries to stabilize that target. **Prepare Before Contact**

- Prepare resistance or mitigation for slashing, piercing damage.
- Carry bait, scent control, and a noncombat retreat route.

**Combat Priority**

Control its escape and feeding choices rather than cornering it.

**Exploit**

The defining weakness is **None identified**. Treat this as an encounter solution rather than an automatic damage vulnerability. Successful Research, Recon, or Resource actions should make the exploit easier or safer.

**Withdraw When**

Withdraw or change the objective when the creature reaches favorable terrain or isolates a target. A failed retreat against this creature usually costs more than abandoning the immediate treasure.
tactics.originalHabitat:
Predators choose terrain that hides approach and protects retreat. The lair is usually more dangerous than the animal.

Not every dangerous creature serves a faction or cosmic principle. Ordinary predators become expedition-level threats when dungeon terrain, repeated Openings, or magical food chains reshape them.

Animal Handling, food, territory, and nonthreatening movement matter more than language.

knowledge.procedure: Retain each dossier's knowledge skill alternatives and its three actual DC thresholds. A focused identification attempt uses one real Search/Research Action in combat with actual observable signs or examined remains, or one uninterrupted minute of ordinary examination outside combat. Meeting successive printed thresholds reveals only the corresponding family/habitat/dominant type, actual first counter/telegraph, then relevant weakness/harvest/retreat facts. A failed attempt does not create false certainty; an identical unaltered evidence check cannot be spammed. New direct observations can update specific facts without retroactively exposing unknown identities. Recognizing a creature is not knowing its language, reading its contract or receiving a public route. LAX keeps speaking/comprehension/reading/writing/script and physical channels distinct. Individual proposed language competencies below are explicit NEW roster defaults, not grants to observers, all members of an ancestry or unnamed populations. Actual anatomy, silence, hearing, light and usable writing tools still govern communication. Social credentials and promises use actual EX58 records; a failed negotiation is not an invented charm, compelled confession or global reputation loss.

tactics.originalHowItFights: It opens with **Void Rend** against the target most capable of controlling its movement. It uses **Psychic Pulse** to punish anyone who tries to stabilize that target. It changes angle, route, or target whenever the Expedition repeats a successful pattern.
tactics.originalHowToDefeat:
**Prepare Before Contact**

- Prepare resistance or mitigation for psychic damage.
- Mark routes with physical cord and damp vibration.

**Combat Priority**

Stabilize or destroy the breach anchor before the room rewrites the fight.

**Exploit**

The defining weakness is **stabilized geometry and vibration damping**. Treat this as an encounter solution rather than an automatic damage vulnerability. Successful Research, Recon, or Resource actions should make the exploit easier or safer.

**Withdraw When**

Withdraw or change the objective when the creature reaches favorable terrain or isolates a target. A failed retreat against this creature usually costs more than abandoning the immediate treasure.

tactics.originalHowItFights: It opens with **Crushing Maw** against the target most capable of controlling its movement. It uses **Tail Lash** to punish anyone who tries to stabilize that target. It turns corpses, spilled reagents, open wounds, and standing water into additional pressure.
tactics.originalHowToDefeat:
**Prepare Before Contact**

- Prepare resistance or mitigation for piercing, bludgeoning damage.
- Seal skin and breathing; separate fire from concentrated spores.

**Combat Priority**

Remove brood pools, root nodes, corpses, or chemical trails that sustain the creature.

**Exploit**

The defining weakness is **airflow control and source-node destruction**. Treat this as an encounter solution rather than an automatic damage vulnerability. Successful Research, Recon, or Resource actions should make the exploit easier or safer.

**Withdraw When**

Withdraw or change the objective when the creature reaches favorable terrain or isolates a target. A failed retreat against this creature usually costs more than abandoning the immediate treasure.
tactics.originalHabitat:
Marsh lairs use water depth, root tunnels, spore pockets, floating ground, and corrosive pools. Fire solves some problems but can turn enclosed spores into explosions.

Bloomdeep turns hunger, rot, medicine, and reproduction into the same ecological process. Its creatures are dangerous because every wound, corpse, and abandoned ration can become part of the next encounter.

Sporefolk and Poison-Skins can negotiate. Grazers and crawlers are driven by chemical cues; changing scent may redirect them.

A territorial withdrawal decision and an intelligent surrender/parley are choices, not conditions that remove a player's agency. To disengage under threat the creature must spend its own actual Withdraw/Disengage Action and actual movement, or bear ordinary opportunity-attack risk; no guaranteed escape or unearned pursuit distance. Exact route geometry, hazards, loads and chase transitions come from actual EX58 inputs. Adjacent enemies, line of sight and cover are recomputed before each real movement segment. Real retreat leaves actual cargo, mounts, downed bodies and witness histories where their sources place them; success awards no second kill, material bundle, generic XP or faction change. An encounter boundary does not reset resource/source receipts unless their actual rule says it does.

knowledge.original:
Use **Arcana** unless the Director approves a more specific approach.

| Result | Information Learned |
|---|---|
| DC 15 | Creature family, usual habitat, and dominant attack type. |
| DC 19 | The first reliable counter and the sign that its strongest ability is ready. |
| DC 23 | Its defining tactical weakness, safe harvest method, and likely retreat condition. |
knowledge.procedure: Retain each dossier's knowledge skill alternatives and its three actual DC thresholds. A focused identification attempt uses one real Search/Research Action in combat with actual observable signs or examined remains, or one uninterrupted minute of ordinary examination outside combat. Use the real acquired skill and underlying ability, actual helpers and conditions; no stat-block or hidden roster is supplied merely by selecting a UI row. Meeting successive printed thresholds reveals only the corresponding family/habitat/dominant type, actual first counter/telegraph, then relevant weakness/harvest/retreat facts. A failed attempt does not create false certainty; an identical unaltered evidence check cannot be spammed. New direct observations can update specific facts without retroactively exposing unknown identities. Recognizing a creature is not knowing its language, reading its contract or receiving a public route. LAX keeps speaking/comprehension/reading/writing/script and physical channels distinct. Individual proposed language competencies below are explicit NEW roster defaults, not grants to observers, all members of an ancestry or unnamed populations. Actual anatomy, silence, hearing, light and usable writing tools still govern communication. Social credentials and promises use actual EX58 records; a failed negotiation is not an invented charm, compelled confession or global reputation loss.

tactics.originalHowItFights: It opens with **Resonant Lash** against the target most capable of controlling its movement. It uses **Echo Needle** to punish anyone who tries to stabilize that target. When **Subsonic Chord** recharges, it delays only if it can catch a more important cluster or interrupt a decisive ritual. It escalates by phase and uses the Seal Pulse to punish parties that solve damage but ignore the test.
tactics.originalHowToDefeat:
**Prepare Before Contact**

- Prepare resistance or mitigation for thunder, psychic damage.
- Carry ranged attacks, grounding tools, or vertical cover.
- Spread before **Subsonic Chord** becomes available.

**Combat Priority**

Complete the arena objective while maintaining damage pressure.

**Exploit**

The defining weakness is **None identified**. Treat this as an encounter solution rather than an automatic damage vulnerability. Successful Research, Recon, or Resource actions should make the exploit easier or safer.

**Withdraw When**

Withdraw or change the objective when Subsonic Chord catches three or more Expedition members; resources fall below half before the arena mechanic is solved. A failed retreat against this creature usually costs more than abandoning the immediate treasure.
tactics.originalHabitat:
A Gate arena is part of the creature. Terrain, Seal Pulses, objectives, and failure conditions matter as much as hit points.

Gate Guardians are not random apex monsters. Each is a living examination tied to a Division of the dungeon, a Gate Seal, and a principle the Expedition must demonstrate under pressure.

Some Guardians speak, bargain, or test. None are safely reduced to ordinary patrons or quest-givers.
tactics.procedure: At each actual regular START choose from the creature's real perceptions, remembered observations and declared objective: an actual legal source-specific objective/counter first; otherwise the printed How It Fights opening attack, a ready announced area only if its visible recipients suit the objective, then a legal native sequence. A failed path or unavailable target does not grant hidden location knowledge or teleportation. A territorial withdrawal decision and an intelligent surrender/parley are choices, not conditions that remove a player's agency. To disengage under threat the creature must spend its own actual Withdraw/Disengage Action and actual movement, or bear ordinary opportunity-attack risk; no guaranteed escape or unearned pursuit distance. Exact route geometry, hazards, loads and chase transitions come from actual EX58 inputs. Adjacent enemies, line of sight and cover are recomputed before each real movement segment. Real retreat leaves actual cargo, mounts, downed bodies and witness histories where their sources place them; success awards no second kill, material bundle, generic XP or faction change. An encounter boundary does not reset resource/source receipts unless their actual rule says it does.
tactics.arenaNarrativeBoundary: Gate test victory, alleged origins, memories and route rewards remain source narrative, not automatic hidden mechanics. An unprinted Seal Pulse is not a second new damage action; the printed recharge supplies the operational burst until separately authored evidence says otherwise.

profiles.defenseProcedure: Use exact printed typed defenses; disease label is prevention of actual disease acquisition/progression only, not a damage type, Poison immunity or resistance to every associated attack. Real direct damage and non-disease riders remain. Resolve attack rolls with natural1 miss/natural20 hit and doubled dice only, not doubled flat modifiers. A save is binary meeting DC; natural20 is not automatic save success. Use actual typed defenses and temporary HP, then actual normal-HP loss and overkill. CORE ordering: lethal instant-death threshold precedes a living recipient's Wound check; otherwise one qualifying Wound check occurs on positive-to-zero or post-temp damage at least half effective maximum. DC=max(10,floor(post-temp/2)); subtract pre-event Wounds from the CON save. Failure adds one Wound; a fourth Wound kills. Failure by at least5 also uses the actual d6 injury result. Do not reduce maximum HP merely because a Wound was added: Critical's ordinary-heal ceiling is not a maximum-HP clamp. Ordinary monsters reaching zero die/end after their actual life sequence unless a real valid knockout or source override applies. Significant-NPC death-save handling must be declared before the event. Death is distinct from zero, suppression, disappearance, and harvest availability. Each attack names the creature as dealer; controller Null does not transfer to it. A qualifying actual Null root inherits its original dealer snapshot; it prevents only the applicable damage-caused lethal/Wound endpoint and keeps non-damage costs and riders. Ordinary living profiles use Stable0 and the one actual Stable clock. Printed Constructs are explicitly nonliving Constructs and use accepted Null Disabled0 without creating salvage. NEW for only the four printed Undead here: ordinary damage at zero destroys the same body into its finite native remains; a qualifying Null root instead leaves the same nonliving body Null Disabled0, no corpse/soul/loot. This is not the named Silence Wraith projection rule, a resurrection, generic repair or a global Undead physiology. Only a real compatible recovery source restores a disabled nonliving body. Roots, life events and finite-remains claims are durable and idempotent. Existing Core detail: each Wound penalizes CON saves and normal Hit-Dice recovery maximum by1 only; at3Wounds Critical gives Speed-10ft and ordinary-heal ceiling max(1,effectiveMaximum-1), not maximum-HP loss. Actual linked injury d6:1Concussion(-1future Initiative/Perception),2OffensiveTrauma(-1attacks),3MobilityTrauma(-5nonteleportSpeeds),4FineMotor(-1tools/manipulationDEX),5Exertion(-1STR/DEXabilitychecks),6Cognitive(-1INT/WIS/CHAabilitychecks). tactics.originalHowItFights: It opens with **Hooked Claw** against the target most capable of controlling its movement. It uses **Tail Lash** to punish anyone who tries to stabilize that target. It turns corpses, spilled reagents, open wounds, and standing water into additional pressure.
tactics.originalHowToDefeat:
**Prepare Before Contact**

- Prepare resistance or mitigation for slashing, bludgeoning damage.
- Seal skin and breathing; separate fire from concentrated spores.

**Combat Priority**

Remove brood pools, root nodes, corpses, or chemical trails that sustain the creature.

**Exploit**

The defining weakness is **airflow control and source-node destruction**. Treat this as an encounter solution rather than an automatic damage vulnerability. Successful Research, Recon, or Resource actions should make the exploit easier or safer.

**Withdraw When**

Withdraw or change the objective when the creature reaches favorable terrain or isolates a target. A failed retreat against this creature usually costs more than abandoning the immediate treasure.
tactics.originalHabitat:
Marsh lairs use water depth, root tunnels, spore pockets, floating ground, and corrosive pools. Fire solves some problems but can turn enclosed spores into explosions.

Bloomdeep turns hunger, rot, medicine, and reproduction into the same ecological process. Its creatures are dangerous because every wound, corpse, and abandoned ration can become part of the next encounter.

Sporefolk and Poison-Skins can negotiate. Grazers and crawlers are driven by chemical cues; changing scent may redirect them.

A territorial withdrawal decision and an intelligent surrender/parley are choices, not conditions that remove a player's agency. To disengage under threat the creature must spend its own actual Withdraw/Disengage Action and actual movement, or bear ordinary opportunity-attack risk; no guaranteed escape or unearned pursuit distance. Exact route geometry, hazards, loads and chase transitions come from actual EX58 inputs. Adjacent enemies, line of sight and cover are recomputed before each real movement segment. Real retreat leaves actual cargo, mounts, downed bodies and witness histories where their sources place them; success awards no second kill, material bundle, generic XP or faction change. harvest.manifestAlgorithm: At actual remains availability, assign remainsId/bodyId/deathTime and all prior damage/custody/claims. Roll one size pool (Tiny1, Small1d2, Medium1d4, Large2d4,Huge4d4) under the accepted finite framework. Resolve each native category availability d100 once. harvest.selectionAndTime: Choose categories from the complete available manifest. knowledge.original:
Use **History or Insight** unless the Director approves a more specific approach.

| Result | Information Learned |
|---|---|
| DC 11 | Creature family, usual habitat, and dominant attack type. |
| DC 15 | The first reliable counter and the sign that its strongest ability is ready. |
| DC 19 | Its defining tactical weakness, safe harvest method, and likely retreat condition. |
knowledge.procedure: Retain each dossier's knowledge skill alternatives and its three actual DC thresholds. A focused identification attempt uses one real Search/Research Action in combat with actual observable signs or examined remains, or one uninterrupted minute of ordinary examination outside combat. Use the real acquired skill and underlying ability, actual helpers and conditions; no stat-block or hidden roster is supplied merely by selecting a UI row. Meeting successive printed thresholds reveals only the corresponding family/habitat/dominant type, actual first counter/telegraph, then relevant weakness/harvest/retreat facts. A failed attempt does not create false certainty; an identical unaltered evidence check cannot be spammed. New direct observations can update specific facts without retroactively exposing unknown identities. Recognizing a creature is not knowing its language, reading its contract or receiving a public route. LAX keeps speaking/comprehension/reading/writing/script and physical channels distinct. Individual proposed language competencies below are explicit NEW roster defaults, not grants to observers, all members of an ancestry or unnamed populations. Actual anatomy, silence, hearing, light and usable writing tools still govern communication. Social credentials and promises use actual EX58 records; a failed negotiation is not an invented charm, compelled confession or global reputation loss.

tactics.originalHowItFights: It opens with **Precise Cut** against the target most capable of controlling its movement. It uses prepared cover and retreats behind the next defensive layer when the first is lost.
tactics.originalHowToDefeat:
**Prepare Before Contact**

- Prepare resistance or mitigation for slashing damage.
- Map doors, bridges, and firing lanes before parley fails.

**Combat Priority**

Deny prepared terrain and command figures; accept surrender when the objective is secured.

**Exploit**

The defining weakness is **None identified**. Treat this as an encounter solution rather than an automatic damage vulnerability. Successful Research, Recon, or Resource actions should make the exploit easier or safer.

**Withdraw When**

Withdraw or change the objective when the creature reaches favorable terrain or isolates a target. A failed retreat against this creature usually costs more than abandoning the immediate treasure.
tactics.originalHabitat:
Defended holds use layered doors, murder shafts, water traps, narrow bridges, and negotiated kill zones. Religious sites add chanting pools, toxin vents, and captive witnesses.

The deep folk are not one faction. They are cultures forced into the same trade roads, flooded caverns, and defensive wars. Their encounters should begin with motive before initiative.

Deep folk respond to ownership, passage rights, debts, clan names, and proof of common enemies.
tactics.procedure: At each actual regular START choose from the creature's real perceptions, remembered observations and declared objective: an actual legal source-specific objective/counter first; otherwise the printed How It Fights opening attack, a ready announced area only if its visible recipients suit the objective, then a legal native sequence. A failed path or unavailable target does not grant hidden location knowledge or teleportation. A territorial withdrawal decision and an intelligent surrender/parley are choices, not conditions that remove a player's agency. To disengage under threat the creature must spend its own actual Withdraw/Disengage Action and actual movement, or bear ordinary opportunity-attack risk; no guaranteed escape or unearned pursuit distance. Exact route geometry, hazards, loads and chase transitions come from actual EX58 inputs. Adjacent enemies, line of sight and cover are recomputed before each real movement segment. Real retreat leaves actual cargo, mounts, downed bodies and witness histories where their sources place them; success awards no second kill, material bundle, generic XP or faction change. An encounter boundary does not reset resource/source receipts unless their actual rule says it does.

knowledge.procedure: Retain each dossier's knowledge skill alternatives and its three actual DC thresholds. A focused identification attempt uses one real Search/Research Action in combat with actual observable signs or examined remains, or one uninterrupted minute of ordinary examination outside combat. tactics.originalHowItFights: It opens with **Weapon Strike** against the target most capable of controlling its movement. It uses **Off-hand Strike** to punish anyone who tries to stabilize that target. It uses prepared cover and retreats behind the next defensive layer when the first is lost.
tactics.originalHowToDefeat:
**Prepare Before Contact**

- Prepare resistance or mitigation for slashing, piercing damage.
- Map doors, bridges, and firing lanes before parley fails.

**Combat Priority**

Deny prepared terrain and command figures; accept surrender when the objective is secured.

**Exploit**

The defining weakness is **None identified**. Treat this as an encounter solution rather than an automatic damage vulnerability. Successful Research, Recon, or Resource actions should make the exploit easier or safer.

**Withdraw When**

Withdraw or change the objective when the creature reaches favorable terrain or isolates a target. A failed retreat against this creature usually costs more than abandoning the immediate treasure.
tactics.originalHabitat:
Defended holds use layered doors, murder shafts, water traps, narrow bridges, and negotiated kill zones. Religious sites add chanting pools, toxin vents, and captive witnesses.

The deep folk are not one faction. They are cultures forced into the same trade roads, flooded caverns, and defensive wars. Their encounters should begin with motive before initiative.

Deep folk respond to ownership, passage rights, debts, clan names, and proof of common enemies.
tactics.procedure: At each actual regular START choose from the creature's real perceptions, remembered observations and declared objective: an actual legal source-specific objective/counter first; otherwise the printed How It Fights opening attack, a ready announced area only if its visible recipients suit the objective, then a legal native sequence. A failed path or unavailable target does not grant hidden location knowledge or teleportation. A territorial withdrawal decision and an intelligent surrender/parley are choices, not conditions that remove a player's agency. To disengage under threat the creature must spend its own actual Withdraw/Disengage Action and actual movement, or bear ordinary opportunity-attack risk; no guaranteed escape or unearned pursuit distance. Exact route geometry, hazards, loads and chase transitions come from actual EX58 inputs. Adjacent enemies, line of sight and cover are recomputed before each real movement segment. Real retreat leaves actual cargo, mounts, downed bodies and witness histories where their sources place them; success awards no second kill, material bundle, generic XP or faction change. An encounter boundary does not reset resource/source receipts unless their actual rule says it does.
tactics.arenaNarrativeBoundary: Gate test victory, alleged origins, memories and route rewards remain source narrative, not automatic hidden mechanics. An unprinted Seal Pulse is not a second new damage action; the printed recharge supplies the operational burst until separately authored evidence says otherwise.

knowledge.original:
Use **History or Insight** unless the Director approves a more specific approach.

| Result | Information Learned |
|---|---|
| DC 11 | Creature family, usual habitat, and dominant attack type. |
| DC 15 | The first reliable counter and the sign that its strongest ability is ready. |
| DC 19 | Its defining tactical weakness, safe harvest method, and likely retreat condition. |
knowledge.procedure: Retain each dossier's knowledge skill alternatives and its three actual DC thresholds. A focused identification attempt uses one real Search/Research Action in combat with actual observable signs or examined remains, or one uninterrupted minute of ordinary examination outside combat. Use the real acquired skill and underlying ability, actual helpers and conditions; no stat-block or hidden roster is supplied merely by selecting a UI row. Meeting successive printed thresholds reveals only the corresponding family/habitat/dominant type, actual first counter/telegraph, then relevant weakness/harvest/retreat facts. A failed attempt does not create false certainty; an identical unaltered evidence check cannot be spammed. New direct observations can update specific facts without retroactively exposing unknown identities. Recognizing a creature is not knowing its language, reading its contract or receiving a public route. LAX keeps speaking/comprehension/reading/writing/script and physical channels distinct. Individual proposed language competencies below are explicit NEW roster defaults, not grants to observers, all members of an ancestry or unnamed populations. Actual anatomy, silence, hearing, light and usable writing tools still govern communication. Social credentials and promises use actual EX58 records; a failed negotiation is not an invented charm, compelled confession or global reputation loss.

tactics.originalHowItFights: It opens with **Weapon Strike** against the target most capable of controlling its movement. When **Pressure Wave** recharges, it delays only if it can catch a more important cluster or interrupt a decisive ritual. It uses prepared cover and retreats behind the next defensive layer when the first is lost.
tactics.originalHowToDefeat:
**Prepare Before Contact**

- Prepare resistance or mitigation for slashing, bludgeoning damage.
- Spread before **Pressure Wave** becomes available.
- Map doors, bridges, and firing lanes before parley fails.

**Combat Priority**

Deny prepared terrain and command figures; accept surrender when the objective is secured.

**Exploit**

The defining weakness is **None identified**. Treat this as an encounter solution rather than an automatic damage vulnerability. Successful Research, Recon, or Resource actions should make the exploit easier or safer.

**Withdraw When**

Withdraw or change the objective when Pressure Wave catches three or more Expedition members. A failed retreat against this creature usually costs more than abandoning the immediate treasure.
tactics.originalHabitat:
Defended holds use layered doors, murder shafts, water traps, narrow bridges, and negotiated kill zones. Religious sites add chanting pools, toxin vents, and captive witnesses.

The deep folk are not one faction. They are cultures forced into the same trade roads, flooded caverns, and defensive wars. Their encounters should begin with motive before initiative.

Deep folk respond to ownership, passage rights, debts, clan names, and proof of common enemies.
tactics.procedure: At each actual regular START choose from the creature's real perceptions, remembered observations and declared objective: an actual legal source-specific objective/counter first; otherwise the printed How It Fights opening attack, a ready announced area only if its visible recipients suit the objective, then a legal native sequence. A failed path or unavailable target does not grant hidden location knowledge or teleportation. A territorial withdrawal decision and an intelligent surrender/parley are choices, not conditions that remove a player's agency. To disengage under threat the creature must spend its own actual Withdraw/Disengage Action and actual movement, or bear ordinary opportunity-attack risk; no guaranteed escape or unearned pursuit distance. Exact route geometry, hazards, loads and chase transitions come from actual EX58 inputs. Adjacent enemies, line of sight and cover are recomputed before each real movement segment. Real retreat leaves actual cargo, mounts, downed bodies and witness histories where their sources place them; success awards no second kill, material bundle, generic XP or faction change. An encounter boundary does not reset resource/source receipts unless their actual rule says it does.
tactics.arenaNarrativeBoundary: Gate test victory, alleged origins, memories and route rewards remain source narrative, not automatic hidden mechanics. An unprinted Seal Pulse is not a second new damage action; the printed recharge supplies the operational burst until separately authored evidence says otherwise.

phaseAndMovement.gateAndArena: An actual arena/anchor is a scene input with real location and state. Missing scene content prevents that particular scene-dependent predicate, not the native damage attacks.

tactics.originalHowItFights: It opens with **Heavy Blow** against the target most capable of controlling its movement. It uses **Off-hand Strike** to punish anyone who tries to stabilize that target. It uses prepared cover and retreats behind the next defensive layer when the first is lost.
tactics.originalHowToDefeat:
**Prepare Before Contact**

- Prepare resistance or mitigation for bludgeoning, piercing damage.
- Map doors, bridges, and firing lanes before parley fails.

**Combat Priority**

Deny prepared terrain and command figures; accept surrender when the objective is secured.

**Exploit**

The defining weakness is **None identified**. Treat this as an encounter solution rather than an automatic damage vulnerability. Successful Research, Recon, or Resource actions should make the exploit easier or safer.

**Withdraw When**

Withdraw or change the objective when the creature reaches favorable terrain or isolates a target. A failed retreat against this creature usually costs more than abandoning the immediate treasure.
tactics.originalHabitat:
Defended holds use layered doors, murder shafts, water traps, narrow bridges, and negotiated kill zones. Religious sites add chanting pools, toxin vents, and captive witnesses.

The deep folk are not one faction. They are cultures forced into the same trade roads, flooded caverns, and defensive wars. Their encounters should begin with motive before initiative.

Deep folk respond to ownership, passage rights, debts, clan names, and proof of common enemies.
tactics.procedure: At each actual regular START choose from the creature's real perceptions, remembered observations and declared objective: an actual legal source-specific objective/counter first; otherwise the printed How It Fights opening attack, a ready announced area only if its visible recipients suit the objective, then a legal native sequence. A failed path or unavailable target does not grant hidden location knowledge or teleportation. A territorial withdrawal decision and an intelligent surrender/parley are choices, not conditions that remove a player's agency. To disengage under threat the creature must spend its own actual Withdraw/Disengage Action and actual movement, or bear ordinary opportunity-attack risk; no guaranteed escape or unearned pursuit distance. Exact route geometry, hazards, loads and chase transitions come from actual EX58 inputs. Adjacent enemies, line of sight and cover are recomputed before each real movement segment. Real retreat leaves actual cargo, mounts, downed bodies and witness histories where their sources place them; success awards no second kill, material bundle, generic XP or faction change. tactics.originalHowItFights: It opens with **Hellfire Claw** against the target most capable of controlling its movement. It keeps a witness, hostage, or written object between itself and the Expedition and withdraws into jurisdiction rather than dying for pride.
tactics.originalHowToDefeat:
**Prepare Before Contact**

- Prepare resistance or mitigation for fire damage.
- Carry blank witness cards and refuse unexamined aid.

**Combat Priority**

Destroy or isolate the seal-bearing implement, then pressure the Broker away from witnesses.

**Exploit**

The defining weakness is **destroyed or invalidated contract seals**. Treat this as an encounter solution rather than an automatic damage vulnerability. Successful Research, Recon, or Resource actions should make the exploit easier or safer.

**Withdraw When**

Withdraw or change the objective when the creature reaches favorable terrain or isolates a target. A failed retreat against this creature usually costs more than abandoning the immediate treasure.
tactics.originalHabitat:
Broker sites are legal terrain as much as physical terrain. Seals, witness circles, sample cabinets, toll chains, and written names can become hazards. Destroying the room may activate clauses rather than end them.

Hush-Brokers are fiendish intermediaries who convert fear, silence, quarantine, and contract language into enforceable power. They prefer an Expedition that survives indebted to them over one that dies free.

They bargain sincerely inside the exact wording they offer. Precision protects an Expedition better than moral outrage.

tactics.originalHowItFights: It opens with **Abyssal Rend** against the target most capable of controlling its movement. It uses **Soul Burn** to punish anyone who tries to stabilize that target. It changes angle, route, or target whenever the Expedition repeats a successful pattern.
tactics.originalHowToDefeat:
**Prepare Before Contact**

- Prepare resistance or mitigation for necrotic, fire damage.
- Mark routes with physical cord and damp vibration.

**Combat Priority**

Stabilize or destroy the breach anchor before the room rewrites the fight.

**Exploit**

The defining weakness is **stabilized geometry and vibration damping**. Treat this as an encounter solution rather than an automatic damage vulnerability. Successful Research, Recon, or Resource actions should make the exploit easier or safer.

**Withdraw When**

Withdraw or change the objective when the creature reaches favorable terrain or isolates a target. A failed retreat against this creature usually costs more than abandoning the immediate treasure.
tactics.originalHabitat:
Breach lairs are shaped by impossible shortcuts, thin walls, sudden gravity changes, and resonant surfaces. A straight retreat may return the party to the fight.

Spiral creatures arise where geometry, memory, and matter cease agreeing. Some are born animals altered by repeated exposure; others are organized broods that cultivate breaches and use them as roads, nurseries, or weapons.

Most breach fauna cannot bargain. Brood-Sages and certain Fracture-Kin can exchange information, but their concept of identity may not match the speaker’s.
tactics.procedure: At each actual regular START choose from the creature's real perceptions, remembered observations and declared objective: an actual legal source-specific objective/counter first; otherwise the printed How It Fights opening attack, a ready announced area only if its visible recipients suit the objective, then a legal native sequence. A failed path or unavailable target does not grant hidden location knowledge or teleportation. A territorial withdrawal decision and an intelligent surrender/parley are choices, not conditions that remove a player's agency. To disengage under threat the creature must spend its own actual Withdraw/Disengage Action and actual movement, or bear ordinary opportunity-attack risk; no guaranteed escape or unearned pursuit distance. Exact route geometry, hazards, loads and chase transitions come from actual EX58 inputs. Adjacent enemies, line of sight and cover are recomputed before each real movement segment. Real retreat leaves actual cargo, mounts, downed bodies and witness histories where their sources place them; success awards no second kill, material bundle, generic XP or faction change. An encounter boundary does not reset resource/source receipts unless their actual rule says it does.

An unprinted Seal Pulse is not a second new damage action; the printed recharge supplies the operational burst until separately authored evidence says otherwise.

harvest.identification: One minute actual close examination: native knowledge skill/INT, except Medicine/WIS; actual relevant proficiency only. One actually trained assistant+1 spends the same minute. Success exposes real recorded categories, hazards and clocks, not unobserved hidden sources. Failure no hidden qualities; plainly recognizable unidentified work may proceed at the actual disadvantage. No unchanged-evidence roll spam.
harvest.extraction: The printed body-level skill/DC/time expressly governs removal for this source, overriding generic body time/DC; missing two use their labelled completion. It authorizes that actual skill as a removal route but grants neither training nor tools. A properly qualified actual gathering trade can supply its own genuine route. No double PB from skill plus tool. One eligible assistant+1 spends the entire extraction time.
harvest.manifestAlgorithm: At actual remains availability, assign remainsId/bodyId/deathTime and all prior damage/custody/claims. Roll one size pool (Tiny1, Small1d2, Medium1d4, Large2d4,Huge4d4) under the accepted finite framework. Resolve each native category availability d100 once. NEW allocation: order eligible categories by original occurrence; if more than one, roll uniform starting ordinal 1..N and distribute the one pool round-robin from there, respecting each actual anatomical cap and measured remaining mass. No eligible category means pool yields nothing. Record fixed unit IDs/allocation before worker choice; do not redirect forfeited quantities. One actual unit cannot belong to two categories. No exceptional additive drop is inferred here.
harvest.selectionAndTime: Choose categories from the complete available manifest. Full time is this exact source time; partial time is ceil(fullMinutes*chosenCategories/availableCategories), minimum1minute. All unselected ordinary categories are forfeited when work begins. Hurry halves that actual required time with upward minute rounding and disadvantage. No Craftsman/Spell Scribe research/manufacturing discount shortens harvest.
harvest.workAndInterruption: NEW harvest-only physical progress completion: record actual exclusive active seconds of usable removal work; safe pauses retain only physically usable progress, clocks continue and real damage can destroy work/stock. No crafting incorporation stabilization or study-phase clock is imported. An interrupted unfinished attempt resumes the same selected finite units and original receipts, not a new yield roll. Completed failure exhausts that selected attempt. Another worker requires genuine access/skill and inherits existing physical progress, never duplicated hours or fresh material.
harvest.resolution: Core four-degree extraction check. Success recovers selected intact allocated units. Critical success additionally saves at most one predeclared damaged/recoverable selected unit within the same anatomical cap; no nonexistent bonus. Failure ruins the highest-reference selected unit (actual tie choice recorded), recovers none, and exhausts selection. Critical failure ruins all selected units, with only actual declared hazard; absent one, real1d4 minor physical accident to lead. No new retry or repeated corpse conversion.
harvest.custodyAndAftermath: Award actual identified lots once at completion, with source occurrence, unit ID, quantity, weight, current condition, clock, owner/claimant and custodian kept separate. Real carried gear is separate and not duplicated by harvest. Humanoid/celestial remains require actual consent/lawful authority/explicit dark-path source. A destroyed or Null-disabled living body is not automatically eligible remains. Magical projections, companions and Simulacra keep their own accepted no-farming/lifecycle procedures.
harvest.noGuaranteedEquivalence: Every global material/recipe-name comparison is retained separately. A source-local unit is not that named catalog ingredient until actual properties/tier/form/amount/provenance satisfy the accepted exact card or a legitimate substitution record. Unresolved recipe labels remain unresolved references, not approved formulas or nonexistent history.

profiles.defenseProcedure: Use exact printed typed defenses; disease label is prevention of actual disease acquisition/progression only, not a damage type, Poison immunity or resistance to every associated attack. Real direct damage and non-disease riders remain. Resolve attack rolls with natural1 miss/natural20 hit and doubled dice only, not doubled flat modifiers. A save is binary meeting DC; natural20 is not automatic save success. Use actual typed defenses and temporary HP, then actual normal-HP loss and overkill. CORE ordering: lethal instant-death threshold precedes a living recipient's Wound check; otherwise one qualifying Wound check occurs on positive-to-zero or post-temp damage at least half effective maximum. DC=max(10,floor(post-temp/2)); subtract pre-event Wounds from the CON save. Failure adds one Wound; a fourth Wound kills. Failure by at least5 also uses the actual d6 injury result. Do not reduce maximum HP merely because a Wound was added: Critical's ordinary-heal ceiling is not a maximum-HP clamp. Ordinary monsters reaching zero die/end after their actual life sequence unless a real valid knockout or source override applies. Significant-NPC death-save handling must be declared before the event. Death is distinct from zero, suppression, disappearance, and harvest availability. Each attack names the creature as dealer; controller Null does not transfer to it. A qualifying actual Null root inherits its original dealer snapshot; it prevents only the applicable damage-caused lethal/Wound endpoint and keeps non-damage costs and riders. Ordinary living profiles use Stable0 and the one actual Stable clock. Printed Constructs are explicitly nonliving Constructs and use accepted Null Disabled0 without creating salvage. NEW for only the four printed Undead here: ordinary damage at zero destroys the same body into its finite native remains; a qualifying Null root instead leaves the same nonliving body Null Disabled0, no corpse/soul/loot. This is not the named Silence Wraith projection rule, a resurrection, generic repair or a global Undead physiology. Only a real compatible recovery source restores a disabled nonliving body. Roots, life events and finite-remains claims are durable and idempotent. Existing Core detail: each Wound penalizes CON saves and normal Hit-Dice recovery maximum by1 only; at3Wounds Critical gives Speed-10ft and ordinary-heal ceiling max(1,effectiveMaximum-1), not maximum-HP loss. Actual linked injury d6:1Concussion(-1future Initiative/Perception),2OffensiveTrauma(-1attacks),3MobilityTrauma(-5nonteleportSpeeds),4FineMotor(-1tools/manipulationDEX),5Exertion(-1STR/DEXabilitychecks),6Cognitive(-1INT/WIS/CHAabilitychecks). Identical/different applicable Injury penalties use their actual strongest-only rule; separate Wound CON penalty remains. Removing the linked Wound removes its injury, not damage or spent resources.

traits.procedure: NEW UG02. Keep observer-private normalized records of actual perceived completed movement polylines and native action signatures within60ft. A movement path repeats only the same occupied-world polyline/direction after removing collinear segmentation; equal distance somewhere else is not equal. An action sequence repeats when its ordered source IDs/modes and actual target identities repeat; new damage dice are not a new sequence. knowledge.original:
Use **Religion** unless the Director approves a more specific approach.

| Result | Information Learned |
|---|---|
| DC 12 | Creature family, usual habitat, and dominant attack type. |
| DC 16 | The first reliable counter and the sign that its strongest ability is ready. |
| DC 20 | Its defining tactical weakness, safe harvest method, and likely retreat condition. |
knowledge.procedure: Retain each dossier's knowledge skill alternatives and its three actual DC thresholds. A focused identification attempt uses one real Search/Research Action in combat with actual observable signs or examined remains, or one uninterrupted minute of ordinary examination outside combat. Use the real acquired skill and underlying ability, actual helpers and conditions; no stat-block or hidden roster is supplied merely by selecting a UI row. Meeting successive printed thresholds reveals only the corresponding family/habitat/dominant type, actual first counter/telegraph, then relevant weakness/harvest/retreat facts. A failed attempt does not create false certainty; an identical unaltered evidence check cannot be spammed. New direct observations can update specific facts without retroactively exposing unknown identities. Recognizing a creature is not knowing its language, reading its contract or receiving a public route. LAX keeps speaking/comprehension/reading/writing/script and physical channels distinct. Individual proposed language competencies below are explicit NEW roster defaults, not grants to observers, all members of an ancestry or unnamed populations. Actual anatomy, silence, hearing, light and usable writing tools still govern communication. Social credentials and promises use actual EX58 records; a failed negotiation is not an invented charm, compelled confession or global reputation loss.

tactics.originalHowItFights: It opens with **Hellfire Claw** against the target most capable of controlling its movement. It uses **Soul Burn** to punish anyone who tries to stabilize that target. It changes angle, route, or target whenever the Expedition repeats a successful pattern.
tactics.originalHowToDefeat:
**Prepare Before Contact**

- Prepare resistance or mitigation for fire damage.
- Mark routes with physical cord and damp vibration.

**Combat Priority**

Stabilize or destroy the breach anchor before the room rewrites the fight.

**Exploit**

The defining weakness is **stabilized geometry and vibration damping**. Treat this as an encounter solution rather than an automatic damage vulnerability. Successful Research, Recon, or Resource actions should make the exploit easier or safer.

**Withdraw When**

Withdraw or change the objective when its full multiattack reaches the support line. A failed retreat against this creature usually costs more than abandoning the immediate treasure.
tactics.originalHabitat:
Breach lairs are shaped by impossible shortcuts, thin walls, sudden gravity changes, and resonant surfaces. A straight retreat may return the party to the fight.

Spiral creatures arise where geometry, memory, and matter cease agreeing. Some are born animals altered by repeated exposure; others are organized broods that cultivate breaches and use them as roads, nurseries, or weapons.

Most breach fauna cannot bargain. Brood-Sages and certain Fracture-Kin can exchange information, but their concept of identity may not match the speaker’s.
tactics.procedure: At each actual regular START choose from the creature's real perceptions, remembered observations and declared objective: an actual legal source-specific objective/counter first; otherwise the printed How It Fights opening attack, a ready announced area only if its visible recipients suit the objective, then a legal native sequence. A failed path or unavailable target does not grant hidden location knowledge or teleportation. A territorial withdrawal decision and an intelligent surrender/parley are choices, not conditions that remove a player's agency. To disengage under threat the creature must spend its own actual Withdraw/Disengage Action and actual movement, or bear ordinary opportunity-attack risk; no guaranteed escape or unearned pursuit distance. Exact route geometry, hazards, loads and chase transitions come from actual EX58 inputs. Adjacent enemies, line of sight and cover are recomputed before each real movement segment. Real retreat leaves actual cargo, mounts, downed bodies and witness histories where their sources place them; success awards no second kill, material bundle, generic XP or faction change. An encounter boundary does not reset resource/source receipts unless their actual rule says it does.
tactics.arenaNarrativeBoundary: Gate test victory, alleged origins, memories and route rewards remain source narrative, not automatic hidden mechanics. An unprinted Seal Pulse is not a second new damage action; the printed recharge supplies the operational burst until separately authored evidence says otherwise.

phaseAndMovement.turnSource: One actually scheduled native regular turn per source sequence; explicit extra-turn providers retain their real limits. These profiles grant none.
phaseAndMovement.timeline: Cases supply numbered-round/turn identities as encounter fixtures; no global seconds-to-round mapping is adopted.
phaseAndMovement.terrainAndStances: Actual Dash/Withdraw/Guard/Brace/Ready/Hide/Search/Help and movement budgets use their accepted Core/Combat action procedures. Narrative Fracture-Kin Nightreaver counterplay grants no free off-turn movement.
phaseAndMovement.gateAndArena: An actual arena/anchor is a scene input with real location and state. Missing scene content prevents that particular scene-dependent predicate, not the native damage attacks.
phaseAndMovement.formationMembership: Printed named units are single actors with explicit member IDs. Other nearby constructs are not joined or cloned by name; Sentinel networks require actual separate bodies.
phaseAndMovement.resetBoundary: No reset on body-fragment selection, mode transition, duplicate event, save/load or alternate route. Real source-ending/reset events retain their exact authority.
